notes: Style 1 is the 10-digit numeric system (fully validated). Style 2 (select PTAC systems manufactured for Goodman by Daikin Industries, serials ending in P or D, ended shortly after the 2012 Daikin acquisition) is chart-verified and shipped (image-pass Nov 8): the chart gives the full month and year letter tables, and the example serial 5FU5472618P decodes as June 2008. Amana is a related brand but its page states no serial system, so it is not listed as a sister sharing this system and has no file (documented gap). The style list variant 9704 011000 shares Style 1's YYMM prefix but has no separately stated decode, so it is not added as an example.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example shown as 97 04811080.

styles.era: Select PTAC systems manufactured for Goodman by Daikin Industries (serials ending in P or D)
styles.notes: Chart-verified (image-pass Nov 8): 1st character is the factory code (single example '5'; the pattern uses a digit class because only a digit is evidenced), 2nd character is the month letter, 3rd character is the year letter. Month and year letters skip I and O. PTAC units only; ended shortly after the 2012 Daikin acquisition.
